address: HimmerLand, Lars Larsens Vej 1, Farsø, 9640, Denmark
bio: The impressive HimmerLand Resort sits in a rural spot, but has everything you need, from hotel rooms and lodges to a spa, tennis courts, bowling and minigolf. It also boasts the small, elegant HimmerRiget, which overlooks the golf course. Both the décor and the cooking are in a modern vein, with the experienced chef creating a seasonal tasting menu that showcases the best of the local larder. Dishes are intricate and well-presented, with a great understanding of balance and flavour, such as in the quenelle of monkfish with beurre blanc and vendace roe. The accompanying wine list is of the highest order....
